title: Nirvana ABSOLUTE Krungthep Kreetha
description: Nirvana Absolute Krungthep Kreetha is a luxury modern housing project defined by its sleek architectural design, clean white façades, and striking geometric details that create a refined and contemporary atmosphere. The residences are spacious and thoughtfully designed with high ceilings and seamless indoor–outdoor living, offering both comfort and privacy. The project includes premium facilities such as a swimming pool, fitness center, landscaped garden, clubhouse, 24-hour security, and CCTV for enhanced safety. Conveniently located, it provides easy access to major transport links including MRT, MRTA routes, and the Airport Rail Link, while being close to lifestyle destinations like The Park Avenue, Market Place, The Nine Rama 9, The Mall Bangkapi, and Seacon Square. It is also surrounded by leading educational institutions such as Wellington College International School, Triamudomsuksa School, Assumption University, and NIDA University, as well as top hospitals including Samitivej, Ramkhamhaeng, Vejthani, Kasemrad, and Vibharam, making it ideal for upscale family living.
